The steps occur roughly every 19 points, with minor jitter in exact step timing (±1–2 points) across candidates. Plateau levels increase monotonically across the series, reflecting the underlying linear+quadratic trend in the full time series. Amplitude within each plateau is extremely low: MAD ≤0.0185, 90% amplitude ≤0.08, and roughness/curvature are zero—indicating no oscillatory or noisy dynamics, only quantized-level stability. Peaks are the top edges of steps (flat tops), troughs are the bottom edges (flat bottoms); both are horizontal segments, not rounded extrema. Noise is negligible—values are nearly constant within plateaus, with only tiny quantization-like fluctuations (<0.001). The pattern is highly stable across candidates despite differing absolute levels (medians range from −1.34 to +1.27), confirming that level shifts are part of the expected trend, not anomalies.
